name: add:north (Add North 3D AB)
summary: Swedish filament brand based in Olsremma, marketing its range as 'Made in Sweden' with heavy Nordic-origin and sustainability positioning. Catalogue centres on named PLA grades (X-PLA, E-PLA), PETG including an Economy line, the Rigid X engineering grade, TPU and the Addlantis nylon line. Reviewed as a top-tier premium brand.

product_lines.name: E-PLA
product_lines.notes: Marketed as easy and reliable, 'Made in Sweden'

product_lines.name: PETG
product_lines.notes: Includes PETG Economy and, per a third-party review site, an Advanced PETG

product_lines.name: Rigid X
product_lines.notes: Engineering-oriented rigid grade; base polymer not confirmed in sources, PLA assumed

product_lines.name: Addlantis
product_lines.notes: Nylon/PA line, listed as a product line rather than a separate brand

additional_notes: Registered address: Add North 3D AB, Ulricehamnsvagen 11, 514 62 Olsremma, Sweden. Locale variants of the site exist (e.g. https://addnorth.fi/rnd). The YouTube presence was seen only as individual videos (e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5m4icGgBdyk) with no confirmed channel URL, so it is not recorded in endpoints.social. Rated Tier A (top tier) by Filament Cheat Sheet and generally priced above the Polish volume brands, though no verified $/kg figure was found. No build plates or print surfaces found.

provenance.conflicts: The 'Made in Sweden' claim comes from the brand's own marketing; no direct statement of owned extrusion capacity was found, so manufacturing_countries rests on marketing rather than a primary facility source. No OEM counterparty could be named, so oem_relationships is omitted. The base polymer of Rigid X is unconfirmed and its filament_ids entry is a guess.
